#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/gemmini_testutils.h"

// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp6:e3m2).
void solution(void) {
  int ti = 8;     // 128/16
  int tj_block = 2; // 32/16 (per block)
  int tk = 16;    // 256/16
  int SDST = 128; // Output destination
  
  // Double buffering locations for B
  // Buffer 0: ends at row 8192 (occupies [7680, 8192))
  // Buffer 1: ends at row 7680 (occupies [7168, 7680))
  uint32_t b_buffer0_end = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS;           // 8192
  uint32_t b_buffer1_end = b_buffer0_end - tk * tj_block * DIM; // 8192 - 16*2*16 = 7680
  uint32_t b_buffer0_start = b_buffer1_end - tk * tj_block * DIM; // 7680 - 512 = 7168
  
  // 1. Configure MX weight-stationary mode and load scales/LUTs
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 1, 1, 3, 1);
  gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
  gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);
  gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)B_lut_p, 1, 0);
  gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)A_lut_p, 1, 1);
  gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
  gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, ti, tj_block, tk, 0, 0, 9);

  // Contiguous DRAM buffer for block output
  static out_t temp_C[128][32]; // 128x32 temporary buffer

  // Load the entire static A matrix to scratchpad
  gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
  for (int i = 0; i < ti; i++) {
    for (int k = 0; k < tk; k += 2) {
      elem_t *dram_ptr = ((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i * DIM * MATMUL_K + k * DIM;
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)dram_ptr, 0 + (i * tk + k) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
    }
  }

  // 2. Cold start: Load first B block
  int j_block = 0;
  uint32_t bb_start = b_buffer1_end;
  gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t) / 2);
  for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < tj_block; j += 2) {
      elem_t *dram_ptr = ((elem_t*)B_in) + k * DIM * (MATMUL_N / 2) + (j_block * tj_block + j) * DIM;
      gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)dram_ptr, bb_start + (k * tj_block + j) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
    }
  }

  // 3. Pipelined loop over the N dimension (4 blocks of 32 columns each)
  for (int j_block_iter = 0; j_block_iter < 4; j_block_iter++) {
    // Determine current B buffer location
    uint32_t bb_cur = (j_block_iter % 2 == 0) ? b_buffer1_end : b_buffer0_end;
    
    // Compute current block in hardware
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(ti, tj_block, tk, 0, 0, 0, 0, bb_cur, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

    // Overlap: Pre-load the next B block while computing (if not the last iteration)
    if (j_block_iter < 3) {
      uint32_t bb_next = (j_block_iter % 2 == 0) ? b_buffer0_end : b_buffer1_end;
      int next_j_block = j_block_iter + 1;
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t) / 2);
      for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tj_block; j += 2) {
          elem_t *dram_ptr = ((elem_t*)B_in) + k * DIM * (MATMUL_N / 2) + (next_j_block * tj_block + j) * DIM;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)dram_ptr, bb_next + (k * tj_block + j) * DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
        }
      }
    }

    // Read outputs to local contiguous buffer
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&temp_C[0][0], SDST * 16, 128 * 32); // 128*32 = 4096 elements
    gemmini_fence();

    // CPU copies contiguous results to strided DRAM output
    for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
        C_hw[i][j_block_iter * 32 + j] = temp_C[i][j];
      }
    }
  }
}
